lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.qi_guiding.desc: Sense ambient qi and guide it inward, unlocking basic manuals, journals and meditation cushions.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.circulation.desc: Complete meridian circulation to unlock seated meditation, route growth, built-in spell graphs and secondary manuals.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.body_tempering.d: Temper sinew and bone with qi, unlocking the body-tempering route and Marrow Pill.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.fetal_breath.des: Sustain internal respiration through qi, unlocking the fetal-breath route and Breath Pill.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.bigu.desc: Nourish the body with ambient qi instead of grain, unlocking the bigu route and Fast Pill.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_stones.de: Understand spirit stone matrices, crystal shards and dust, unlocking spirit stones and the Spirit Compass.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.qi_refining.desc: Condense a stable sea of qi, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 1 (Qi Refining).
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.foundation_build: Forge an unshakeable cultivation foundation, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 2 (Foundation Building).
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.golden_core.desc: Crystallize inner qi into a Golden Core, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 3 (Golden Core).
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.nascent_soul.des: Awaken the Nascent Soul within the core, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 4 (Nascent Soul).
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_transform: harmonize spirit with heaven and earth, unlocking breakthrough into Realm 5 (Spirit Transformation).
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_materials: Refine metals, glass and silk with qi to produce Spirit Iron Blanks, Ingots, Spirit Glass and Spirit Thread.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.pill_refining.de: Master furnace heat control and herbal blending, unlocking the Alchemy Furnace, Cinnabar Spirit Ink and pill refining.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.herb_tasting.des: Identify herbal properties through qi perception and field tasting when formal Materia Medica is unavailable.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.restorative_pill: Refine spirit herbs and spring water into Qi Recovery Pills and Detox Pills.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.breakthrough_pil: Condense high-grade crystals and herbs at intense heat to refine Breakthrough Pills.
Combine classical herbalism with pill alchemy to refine Nourish Qi, Calm Spirit, Clear Heat, Invigorate Blood and Resolve Toxin pills.
Prepare talisman paper, cinnabar ink and brush at the Talisman Table to draw and activate basic talismans.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.fire_talisman.de: Seal elemental flame within a talisman, unlocking Fire Talisman inscription and casting.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.wind_talisman.de: Capture swift wind currents in a talisman, unlocking Wind Talisman inscription and dash casting.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.seal_talisman.de: Bind movement with sealing runes, unlocking Seal Talisman inscription and casting.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.array_basics.des: Use Spirit Stone Cores and Array Rune Stones to construct 3x3 Spirit Arrays.
Erect Array Pillars and craft the Array Control Tablet to expand and manage formations.
Master the five operational modes of formed Spirit Arrays: Gather, Charge, Guard, Alchemy and Seal.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_veins.des: Understand underground Spirit Vein Nodes and Spirit Spring Stones.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.jade_slips.desc: Carve fine jade into Jade Slips, Jade Ward Amulets and Jade Array Plates.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.geomancy.desc: Survey terrain, water and sky alignment with a Geomantic Luopan.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.dragon_vein_seek: Pinpoint chunk acupoints with the Dragon-Seeking Rod and unlock full Luopan sub-score readouts.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.stone_reading.de: Discern jade and strata through mountain forms and qi resonance when formal Geology is unavailable.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.divination.desc: Cast the 64 hexagrams with Divination Coins to forecast weather and receive auspicious omens.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.bone_oracle.desc: Scorch Oracle Bones at night to divine the direction and distance of distant structures.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_beasts.de: Understand spirit creatures and craft Spirit Beast Seals to form lasting contracts.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spirit_farming.d: Collect Spirit Spring Bottles to enrich Spirit Soil and cultivate Spirit Herbs.
lore.xuanhuan_earth.xua.spell_graphs.des: Deduce custom spell graph topologies and load data-driven spell graphs.
Unify inner cultivation, pill alchemy, talismans, formations and divination to unlock heirloom-grade Xuanxue creations.
